5.source_text: “Behold, a King shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

12.source_text: “Behold, a King shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

13.source_text:
And he shall plant in the hearts of the children the promises made
    to the fathers, and the hearts of the children shall turn to their
    fathers; if it were not so, the whole earth would be utterly wasted
    at his coming.
